claims.statement: The Manifold repository declares exactly six console scripts in `pyproject.toml` `[project.scripts]`: `manifold-train`, `manifold-train-reward`, `manifold-train-grpo`, `manifold-train-controlnet`, `manifold-export`, and `manifold-eval`; `pyproject.toml` is the single source of truth that paired-reward deletion guards and the `manifold-eval` install-facing workflow read from.

ADR-0037's observe-only in-training paired-fidelity monitor is shipped on the supervised ControlNet CLI: `controlnet_cli.py` registers `PairedFidelitySpec` under the `paired_fidelity` name on its `CallbackRegistry`, lists it in the default callback-name set alongside `train_loss` and `checkpoint`, and wires the recipe-primary rollout step count through `CallbackContext.inference_recipe["num_inference_steps"]`; the built `PairedFidelityCallback` logs `val/psnr` / `val/ssim` but never drives checkpoint selection (`val/x0_mae` remains the monitor), never enters the loss, and never touches the optimizer or EMA.

`manifold-export`'s `--pipeline` argparse still exposes a `paired` choice in `src/manifold/training/export_cli.py` that references a now-deleted module (`manifold.pipelines.paired_latent_flow.PairedLatentFlowPipeline`); ADR-0034 retired the paired-reward pipeline, so `jit` and `controlnet` are the only supported `--pipeline` choices and `paired` survives only as a stale historical reference.

The `CallbackRegistry` two-phase construction (resolve → build) plus the `TrainingSpine.run` merge order (defaults → knobs → `--callbacks` override → `forbidden_callbacks` / `forbidden_monitors` → resolve → build → `validate_monitor` → fit) is the single source of truth for which callbacks fire and which checkpoint monitors are allowed across every training CLI, with the GRPO ControlNet path passing `forbidden_callbacks={"fid": ...}` and `forbidden_monitors={"val/fid": ...}` to drop FID regardless of YAML or `--callbacks` overrides.

Frozen-arm wiring is owned by `FrozenArmMixin._register_frozen_arm` (register + dual-exclude, ADR-0031 A1) and per-rank CUDA device resolution is owned by `DevicePolicy` (`pin` pre-PG, `warm_device` post-PG, ADR-0035); these are the canonical replacements for the previous `object.__setattr__` bypass, the inline `set_device` twin, the bare `torch.device("cuda")` in the controlnet CLI, and `manifold.data.latent_pipeline.resolve_warm_device`.
